answer.rationale: Hard 18% spend cut plus incumbent refusal to reopen price rules out a same-price renewal and makes a pure negotiate_terms bet weak despite c4. The low-cost quote is the only single decision that meets the cost objective; c2 is the supporting precedent (fast onboard, clean invoices) but it is last-cycle and unverified under today’s 94% no-buffer load. c1 says incumbent renewal avoided integration and delivery interruption, so a primary cutover can raise delivery risk and is flagged. Dual-source (c3) and defer (c5) do not cover a non-auto-renewing primary that lapses in 14 days in a one-decision cycle. Verifying c2 and c1 before commit; full primary replacement is forced by expiry, not a guarded test.
